description: Tutorial lesson T6 (Krumpin'), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t6_fight fixture -> End Pile In -> Boyz fight the Custodian Guard (pick a melee weapon + target, Weapon to Target, Fight!, Fast Roll, Done) -> the WARBOSS takes his Fights First swing before the enemy gets one (Decline Epic Challenge, assign, Fight!) -> the Custodian Guard swings back and its hit/wound rolls are revealed step by step in the resolution dock (spectating: 'Show Wound Roll' / 'Show Saving Throws', no Command Re-roll on the enemy's dice) before the player rolls their own saves -> end the phase. The attack dialog and allocation overlay are embedded modal Windows, so their controls are driven via the emit escape hatch.

steps.script: TutorialManager.active
TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: the SHUFFLE UP! step claims the Boyz are already in contact - no model base anywhere on the board may overlap another (the Custodian Guard used to sit on a 60px pitch, 3px inside each other's 40mm bases)
5 front-rank Boyz + the Warboss are in real base-to-base contact with the Custodian Guard line

every Boy can actually swing - two used to sit >2" from the Custodes and could not fight at all. The full mob fights: melee now honours per-model loadouts, so the Boss Nob's Power klaw is 3 attacks rather than 30

the Warboss token is actually drawn - the fixture used to leave the attached character at UNDEPLOYED, so Main._recreate_unit_visuals() skipped it and da boss was invisible on the board

return d.assignments.size() > 0

the sequencer offers da boss next, not the enemy — Fights First is exhausted before Remaining Combats
selecting a CHARACTER offers EPIC CHALLENGE first; its dialog has auto-named nodes, so find the Decline button by text (tolerant — the offer only appears when the player can pay 1 CP)

steps.comment: the AI now takes its alternating activation (select the Custodian Guard, assign, roll to hit) and then PARKS at the staged hit pause — nothing may press for it, or the reveal the player is meant to watch is gone

THE REPORTED BUG: the enemy's swing back used to resolve hits AND wounds in one shot and hand the player a finished 'N wounds to save' prompt. It now rolls out in the dock the player's own attacks use — spectating, 'Show Wound Roll' rather than 'Roll to Wound' (they are not the player's dice to roll), and no Command Re-roll offered on them.
show the enemy's wound roll
the wound roll is its own step too — the player sees how many wounds are coming before rolling a single save
hand the batch to the player's own save overlay
and the player still rolls their own saves, with the save Command Re-roll available there
Confirm Order & Roll Saves
Keep Rolls / Auto-pick casualties
Done
the enemy really did swing back — and it still had models to do it with (10 Boyz swinging the Boss Nob's Power klaw used to wipe the squad 38% of the time)
